title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred State College on 1970-05-01
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a stellar 1970 acoustic set with tight Race Is On and Wake Up Little Susie, plus strong electric jams—minor Lovelight fade‑out glitch.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller mix delivers astonishing clarity; you can crank it loud and still hear every nuance, even the faint second acoustic guitar on New Speedway. The show is hailed as one of the band’s finest early‑70s acoustic performances with energetic renditions of Race Is On and Wake Up Little Susie, and a second set that jams hard. A single complaint notes a harsh fade‑out on Lovelight, but overall both the music and recording are praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average 4.3/5) with strong praise for performance and exceptional soundboard clarity; only one minor technical complaint.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Exceptionally clear mix – audible left‑channel acoustic guitar, loud‑volume friendly. One reviewer reports a harsh fade‑out on Lovelight near the end.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic first set tight and energetic, followed by a powerful electric second set; the overall pacing and transitions are praised.
